title: Query-optimal quantum simulation of Lindblad evolution
summary: For the problem of simulating Lindblad evolution for time $t$ to precision $ε$, Hamiltonian simulation provides an additive query lower bound, informally, $Ω(t + \mathrm{polylog}(1/ε))$. However, the best previously known algorithms for general Lindblad simulation achieve a multiplicative upper bound, informally, $\mathcal{O}(t\,\mathrm{polylog}(1/ε))$, in query complexity. It has remained open whether this multiplicative dependence is necessary.
